docs.text: The turquoisey color reflected in the glass is thanks to a beautifully colored Lake Michigan. It looked downright tropical.
From the camera roll: An "Off to See the Wizard"-esque path winds through the lake-grasses of Loyola Beach. Yes, this is on Lake Michigan. 😌 Ain't she gorgeous?
